fn vowel_heavy_count(text: String) -> usize {
    let words: Vec<&str> = text.split_whitespace().collect();
    let total = words.len();
    let mut count = 0;
    for w in words {
        let v = w.chars().filter(|c| matches!(c, 'a'|'e'|'i'|'o'|'u')).count();
        let c = w.len() - v;
        if v > c {
            count += 1;
        }
    }
    count
}

fn main() {
    let s = String::from("hello rust beautiful world");
    println!("{}", vowel_heavy_count(s));
}

/// Find target in sorted slice. Returns Some(index) if found, None otherwise.
pub fn binary_search<T: Ord>(arr: &[T], target: &T) -> Option<usize> {
    let mut low = 0;
    let mut high = arr.len() - 1;
    while low <= high {
        let mid = (low + high) / 2;
        match arr[mid].cmp(target) {
            std::cmp::Ordering::Equal => return Some(mid),
            std::cmp::Ordering::Less => low = mid + 1,
            std::cmp::Ordering::Greater => high = mid - 1,
        }
    }
    None
}

use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Parses a string like "foo=bar, baz= qux " into a HashMap.
/// Whitespace around keys and values is trimmed.
/// Returns Err if any pair is missing `=`.
pub fn parse_kv(s: &str) -> Result<HashMap<String, String>, String> {
    let mut out = HashMap::new();
    if s.trim().is_empty() {
        return Ok(out);
    }
    for pair in s.split(',') {
        let pair = pair.trim();
        let (k, v) = pair.split_once('=').ok_or_else(|| format!("missing '=' in pair: {}", pair))?;
        out.insert(k.trim().to_string(), v.trim().to_string());
    }
    Ok(out)
}

fn main() {
    println!("{:?}", parse_kv("a=1, b=2"));
}

fn test_normal() {
    let input = "a=1, b=2";
    let result = parse_kv(input);
    assert_eq!(result, HashMap::from([("a", "1"), ("b", "2")]));
}

#[test]
fn test_multiple_pairs() {
    let input = "foo=bar, baz=qux";
    let result = parse_kv(input);

use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Parses a string like "foo=bar, baz= qux " into a HashMap.
/// Whitespace around keys and values is trimmed.
/// Returns Err if any pair is missing `=`.
pub fn parse_kv(s: &str) -> Result<HashMap<String, String>, String> {
    let mut out = HashMap::new();
    if s.trim().is_empty() {
        return Ok(out);
    }
    for pair in s.split(',') {
        let pair = pair.trim();
        let (k, v) = pair.split_once('=').ok_or_else(|| format!("missing '=' in pair: {}", pair))?;
        out.insert(k.trim().to_string(), v.trim().to_string());
    }
    Ok(out)
}

fn main() {
    println!("{:?}", parse_kv("a=1, b=2"));
}
